# Aurea Hosting

> Boutique short stay management in Adelaide. A small portfolio and a dedicated team.

Request a call. Aurea does not publish or send revenue forecasts. Nightly rates are discussed by phone.

Trading entity: 6IX Services Pty Ltd, operating as Aurea Hosting.
Website: https://aureahosting.com.au/

## What Aurea does

Short stay management for Adelaide property owners. Aurea sets up the listing, manages nightly rates, replies to guests within minutes 7 days a week, coordinates cleaning and linen, oversees maintenance and reports to the owner through a real-time dashboard.

Aurea keeps a small portfolio on purpose. Staying small is the plan. Owners deal with a dedicated team.

## Service area

Adelaide, the coast, the Hills and the Fleurieu.
